rho_reference.protocol: Named by §9.26: on each Stage A curve the 16 <±psi> walks (psi the GLS endomorphism, psi^2 = -1; seeds 1000*seed + k, k < 16), priced in E25's arithmetic (walk (i), the registered comparison) and in E27's (walk (iii): Karatsuba F_p4 products, norm inversions of a 16-walk pool batched); the [d]G = Q check excluded (E25's convention). Strongest available: the validator's own arithmetic shows j in F_p2 but not in F_p, Aut(E) = ±1 and psi^2(G) = -G on all 40 Stage 0 curves (replay/curve_check.json), so <±psi> is the largest fold, and walk (iii) is the cheapest arithmetic built for it (the same walks as (i), checked seed by seed). The band below uses walk (iii); the IC side is MODELLED: S_model = R C + R g + 16 LA (R the tau-psi arm's measured residuals to its logarithm, C the median of 3 measured weighted-D4 solve calls, g the measured generation per target, LA the measured Wiedemann mod-n multiplications), native operations = E19's Macaulay entries per residual at the same p (borrowed). gae_band values: medians over the 10 Stage A curves.
rho_reference.unit: F_p multiplications; LA at 16 F_p multiplications per mod-n multiplication; native operations priced at w * 97 F_p multiplications (GAE = E25's affine addition)
